title: rest: three doors answer an unknown resource as empty or bad input (publish-drafts 200, flow runs 200 [], datasource PATCH 400) where their siblings answer 404
body:
Filing gate: ① a product defect with named locations and a live reproduction (finding class (a); one closing card for the family, per-door rows below).
Reader: the `packages/rest` lane (the three doors in the table below), next PR touching not-found answers on these routes.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "unknown resource answers 200 empty instead of 404 publish-drafts flow runs datasource PATCH" → 27 hits, none on this (nearest: #24768, NOT NULL door parity; #23495, draft doors with no package — both different defects).
reach: public HTTP entry, measured on a fresh boot — all three doors answered as tabulated.
Checklist item priority: P0
type: Bug
QA-source: #25478 · studio-authoring.first-run-loop · observed beside the clauses

Three doors answer a request about a resource that does not exist as if it were an empty or bad request, while their sibling doors answer `404` for the same name. An AI or SDK caller cannot tell "nothing there yet" from "no such thing" (AGENTS.md route rules 3 and 4: absence must be loud, machine-readable surfaces must not lie).

Re-measured by the lead on a fresh stock showcase boot, `main` 77392e90, as admin:

| door | answer | sibling for the same name |
|---|---|---|
| `POST /api/v1/packages/com.example.nope/publish-drafts {}` | `200 {"data":{"success":false,"outcome":"nothing_to_publish",…}}` | the package does not exist; package reads answer 404 |
| `GET /api/v1/automation/no_such_flow_xyz/runs` | `200 {"data":{"runs":[],"hasMore":false}}` | `POST /api/v1/automation/no_such_flow_xyz/trigger` → `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND "Flow 'no_such_flow_xyz' not found"` |
| `PATCH /api/v1/datasources/no_such_ds {"config":{}}` | `400 DATASOURCE_ADMIN_ERROR "Datasource 'no_such_ds' not found."` | `GET /api/v1/datasources/no_such_ds` → `404 RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |

**Expected:** each answers `404` with the same code as its sibling, naming the missing resource. An empty runs list and a `nothing_to_publish` outcome are reserved for resources that exist.

(Found by off-clause probing in QA runs #25478 and #25479: the datasource door beside integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix, and the runs door beside automation.flow-node-type-matrix.)
